subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling & pre-reqs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling & pre-reqs

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a dedicated capacity sizing session on the calendar: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary use case: document summarization + semantic search for customer support.
- Expected traffic pattern: sustained daytime traffic with occasional spikes around product releases.
- Data constraints: PII will be redacted; need private deployment/DEDICATED capacity with SOC2 evidence.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your infra lead and our SE to align on throughput, latency targets, and ops constraints. To make the session productive, please bring or send the items below ahead of the call: 
- Expected peak concurrent requests (or RPS) and average requests per minute.
- Typical and worst-case sequence lengths (tokens) for requests.
- Target latency SLOs (p50/p95) and acceptable tail latencies.
- Model family(s) you prefer (e.g., Llama 3 70B, RedSea-2) and whether you plan to use quantized variants.
- Any compliance/network constraints (VPC, egress rules, KMS/HSM) we should account for.

I attached the discovery notes and a short template to capture capacity numbers if handy.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 15 Sep, 10:00–11:00am
- Tue 15 Sep, 2:00–3:00pm
- Wed 16 Sep, 11:00–12:00pm

Please let me know which slot works or suggest alternatives. We'll have Camila (SE) and Neha (Solutions) on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, capacity_requirements_template.xlsx

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling & pre-reqs

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and template. Priya (our infra lead) is looped in here. We can do Tue 15 Sep at 10:00am PDT — that works best for the team.

Preliminary numbers to help you prep:
- Avg RPS: ~8 requests/sec (~480 rpm) during business hours; peak sustained spike of ~25 RPS for ~10–15 minutes during releases.
- Typical request sequence length: 350 tokens; tail requests up to ~1,200 tokens for long document summaries.
- Target latency: p50 ~80–120ms per token, p95 < 500ms overall generation for most prompts.
- Model: evaluating Llama-3 family and a smaller quantized variant for cheaper inference.

We'll upload a filled version of the capacity template to the Drive link you shared before the meeting.

Alex
Head of ML Platforms
Acme Corp

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 15 Sep 10:00am PDT. I'll prepare the sizing checklist and a couple of candidate configurations.

Pre-call ask (so we can sketch recommendations ahead of time):
- Export of 1 week of production request counts by minute (or a recent peak day) if available.
- Distribution of sequence lengths (histogram or percentiles).
- Any model perf baselines you have (latency per token / tokens per second on current infra).
- Expected concurrency from internal vs. external traffic (if applicable).

I'll attach a short checklist to guide the call. See you Tuesday.

- Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
